note: Round 5b (2026-10-11): soft ethereal whooshes and swells. The operator: "we don't have enough 'soundscape etheral wooshing' type stuff, that would be good to get for many things like hovering cards/buttons and moving things around also", and not happy with the turn start sound.
suffix: Fantasy card game sound effect, soft, airy and ethereal, one smooth gesture that swells and fades, clean. High-quality, stereo, 44.1kHz.
negative: low quality, muffled, lo-fi, noise, hiss, distortion, clipping, music, melody, song, beat, drums, speech, voice, vocals, harsh, loud, repeated hits
